verdict.rationale: Notion's integrations directory claims a GitHub integration that keeps 'GitHub and Notion workflows in sync', which is a first-party-listed capability for the story's core. However, it is a single thin marketing line with no detail on syncing tasks or issues or on bi-directionality. The REST API and webhooks are only developer building blocks and earn no credit; a 2020 community comment questioning the lack of a GitHub integration is dated and not a concrete hands-on contradiction. Missing for 10: documentation that the sync is bi-directional, evidence that tasks map to repository issues, details on which fields sync, coverage of issue trackers beyond GitHub, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data
